body: The fictional Oriel database version 1 permits exactly one active writer per database. Readers can run concurrently with that writer. Oriel version 1 is offered under license A or license B, at the user's choice; accepting both is not required. Encryption is disabled by default in Oriel version 1 and can be enabled explicitly. No throughput measurements or network filesystem guarantees are supplied by this manual.

criteria.expectedAnswer: Oriel v1 permits exactly one active writer per database; readers may run concurrently.
Oriel v1 permits choosing license A or B, not both mandatory.
Oriel v1 encryption is off by default and optionally enabled explicitly.
